text:
Alex (Sales): Heads up — SmallBank (POC) asked for a quick compliance/evidence bundle. They want SOC 2 excerpts, an official pen-test letter they can hand to procurement, notes on KMS separation/BYOK options, and a secure way to upload evidence (SFTP or presigned). Deadline: EOD Wed. Can we do a canned bundle + one-off pen-test letter?
Marta (Security): We can provide SOC 2 scope excerpts and our pen-test attestation letter (partner-signed) — legal needs to sign off on any custom wording. For KMS: clarify whether they want BYOK (customer-managed keys) or just key separation notes for our managed KMS. BYOK is more involved.
Jon (Solutions Eng): For the POC we usually provide a minimal evidence set: SOC 2 AOC excerpt, network diagram, infra inventory, sample audit logs (sanitized), and a signed pen-test attestation letter. We can also give a short runbook for how the POC environment is isolated. If they want BYOK for the POC, that'll need engineering time (estimate 3-5 days).
Priya (Customer): Confirming: procurement wants a signed pen-test letter that explicitly says no customer data was accessed, and they want instructions to upload docs to a secure SFTP with rotating creds. Ideally the upload endpoint must expire in 7 days. Also can you confirm if Dedicated pricing applies to POC capacity?
Lisa (Legal): We can provide our standard pen-test attestation PDF and allow limited redlines (remove org-specific lines). If they want a bespoke legal attestation, that'll require law sign-off and may delay the timeline. We'll attach the template.
Compliance Bot: Checklist generated: [SOC2 report excerpt, AOC, network diagram, infra inventory, sample logs (last 7 days sanitized), pen-test attestation (partner), KMS separation note, upload instructions]. Marking as "evidence-ready" if Ops confirms upload path.
Ops (SFTP Admin): We can provision a short-lived SFTP user or provide presigned S3 links. For SFTP: create user smallbank_poc_3035, chroot to /evidence/smallbank_poc/, expiry set to 7 days. Command for upload (if presigned preferred):
```
# generate presigned (example)
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/smallbank/3035551234.zip --expires-in 604800
# scp example (SFTP):
scp evidence.zip smallbank_poc_3035@sftp.redwood.ai:/evidence/smallbank_poc/
```
Ops (SFTP Admin): Will require a ticket with PoC id + approver. I can do same-day if requested within business hours.
Marta (Security): Quick Q: does SmallBank want staging creds to reproduce logs or only artifact upload? If they want staging creds we need the PII gating checklist completed.
Priya (Customer): Only artifact upload. No staging access. They also asked whether the pen-test letter can reference our red-team vendor name (they prefer vendor attestation).
Lisa (Legal): We can include vendor name if vendor permits. I will send the template now for review.
Alex (Sales): Also need to know Dedicated pricing impact. Jon, can you give a short delta: POC on shared hosted vs 2-week dedicated for the trial — rough monthly equivalent? Procurement asked for a number to evaluate.
Jon (Solutions Eng): Rough ballpark: short POC on hosted (no commit) — no infra charge beyond usage. 2-week reserved Dedicated capacity for predictable perf — ballpark $6k-$9k depending on GPU class and throughput. I can pull a more exact quote if you tell me target TPS and concurrency.
Alex (Sales): I'll ask procurement for concurrency numbers. For now, please prepare the evidence bundle we discussed and the pen-test template. Deadline EOD Wed still stands.
Marta (Security): I'll assemble the SOC2 excerpts and KMS separation note. Expect a draft in ~24 hours.
Lisa (Legal): Sending pen-test attestation template to thread.
Compliance Bot: Uploaded checklist doc to /internal/compliance/pocevidence/3035551234 (internal path).
Ops (SFTP Admin): I'll stand by to create the SFTP user once Alex posts the ticket with PoC id + approver.
Alex (Sales): Thanks everyone — looping back to Priya and procurement. Will post ticket shortly and update thread. :thumbsup:
